text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64.6K with minimal momentum, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 1.3% gain, suggesting some rotation into altcoins despite the broader uncertainty. The Fear & Greed Index at extreme fear (10) and declining sharply over the week indicates capitulation sentiment, though the $70B daily volume remains moderate rather than panicked. BTC dominance at 59.3% reflects persistent preference for Bitcoin in a risk-off environment, but Ethereum and smaller caps moving slightly higher suggest some traders are positioning for recovery rather than liquidating entirely.
